---
title: "Reflections as a graduate student"
date: 2026-07-24
---

In this blog, I will share my thoughts and experiences as a graduate student at Johns Hopkins University. In the era of artificial intelligence, I strongly believe in the importance of documenting how science changes over the course of my PhD. As a student in the Center for Computational Biology (CCB) at Hopkins, I am in a unique position to see the impacts of artificial intelligence on the field of computational biology. I am excited to post about my thoughts in this blog.
